cards.ex: The job interview required an immaculate appearance, so I spent hours getting ready.
cards.exUz: Ish intervyusi uchun bepul ko'rinish talab qilindi, shuning uchun men soatlab tayyorlandim.
cards.uzDef: Juda toza, xatosiz va mukammal ko'rinishga ega bo'lish; hech qanday nuqsoni yo'q.

cards.ex: She maintained a youthful glow well into her fifties through a healthy diet and exercise.
cards.exUz: U sog'lom ovqatlanish va mashqlar orqali ellik yoshlarida ham yoshlik nashrasini saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va yosh ko'rinish, odatda yoshlik bilan bog'liq bo'lgan yorqinlik.

cards.ex: Her radiant smile lit up the entire room when she received the award.
cards.exUz: U mukofotni olganda, uning nurli tabassumi butun xonani yoritib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va baxtli ko'rinadigan tabassum, yuzni yorituvchi tabassum.

cards.ex: Her dress was the epitome of understated elegance; simple, yet stunning.
cards.exUz: Uning libosi soddalashtirilgan nafislikning timsoli edi; oddiy, lekin ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, ammo juda chiroyli va zamonaviy ko'rinish, ortiqcha bezaksiz uslub.

cards.ex: They always told us to dress for success when attending networking events.
cards.exUz: Ular bizga doimo tarmoq tadbirlarida muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun kiyinishni aytishardi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun mos va ishonchli ko'rinishga ega bo'lish uchun kiyinish.

cards.ex: He goes to the gym regularly to keep in trim and maintain his health.
cards.exUz: U sog'lig'ini saqlash va qomatini saqlash uchun doimiy ravishda sport zaliga boradi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy shaklni yaxshi holatda saqlash, sog'lom va ozg'in bo'lish.

cards.ex: The stress of the job really made him show his age.
cards.exUz: Ishning bosimi uni haqiqatan ham yoshini ko'rsatishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishidan yoshi kattaligini ko'rsatish, qarilik alomatlarini namoyon qilish.

cards.ex: She has such a presence; everyone notices when she walks into a room.
cards.exUz: U shunday ta'sirga ega; u xonaga kirganda hamma sezadi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortadigan va esda qoladigan kuchli va sezilarli ta'sirga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He always has a dapper appearance, even when he's just running errands.
cards.exUz: U doimo jiddiy ko'rinishga ega, hatto faqatgina ishlarni bajarayotganda ham.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli, toza va zamonaviy kiyingan ko'rinish, ayniqsa erkaklar uchun.

cards.ex: After a good night's sleep, she always wakes up with a fresh face.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi uxlagandan so'ng, u har doim tetik yuz bilan uyg'onadi.
cards.uzDef: Charchoq va stresssiz ko'rinadigan, sog'lom va tetik yuz.

cards.ex: "Age before beauty," he joked, gesturing for his grandmother to go first.
cards.exUz: "Yoshga hurmat," deb hazillashdi u, buvisi birinchi borishi uchun imo qilib.
cards.uzDef: Kattalarga hurmat ko'rsatish, ularga ustunlik berish (ko'pincha hazilomuz tarzda).

cards.ex: She prefers a classic look with simple dresses and elegant jewelry.
cards.exUz: U oddiy ko'ylaklar va nafis taqinchoqlar bilan klassik ko'rinishni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Modadan qolmaydigan, doimo zamonaviy va nafis ko'rinish.

cards.ex: The office dress code is business casual, so no jeans or t-shirts.
cards.exUz: Ofis kiyinish qoidasi biznes-kundalik, shuning uchun jinsi shimlar yoki futbolkalar yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan joy yoki vaziyat uchun qabul qilingan kiyim qoidalari.

cards.ex: Her bright red dress made her stand out in the crowd.
cards.exUz: Uning yorqin qizil libosi uni olomondan ajralib turishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xosligi yoki go'zalligi bilan boshqalardan ajralib turmoq.

cards.ex: She has an effortless style; she always looks great without trying too hard.
cards.exUz: U oson uslubga ega; u doimo juda ko'p harakat qilmasdan ham ajoyib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Urinmasdan ham ajoyib ko'rinish, tabiiy nafislik.

cards.ex: He turned up looking like he hadn't slept in days.
cards.exUz: U bir necha kun uxlamaganga o'xshab ko'rinib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rinish berish; odatda kutilmagan yoki ma'lum bir tarzda paydo bo'lish.

cards.ex: Many people consider a well-defined jawline to be an attractive feature.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik yaxshi aniqlangan jag' chizig'ini jozibador xususiyat deb hisoblaydi.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlik bilan ko'rinib turadigan, yaxshi shakllangan jag' chizig'i.

cards.ex: People often judge others based on their outer appearance, which is unfair.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ko'pincha boshqalarni tashqi ko'rinishiga qarab baholaydilar, bu adolatsizlik.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tashqi tomondan ko'rinishi, uning jismoniy ko'rinishi.

cards.ex: She loves to be made up for special occasions.
cards.exUz: U maxsus tadbirlar uchun bezanishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Kosmetik vositalar yordamida go'zallikni ta'kidlash yoki o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: The bride was a sight to behold in her stunning white gown.
cards.exUz: Kelin o'zining ajoyib oq libosida tomosha qilishga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda go'zal yoki ta'sirli ko'rinishga ega bo'lish, tomosha qilishga arziydigan narsa.

cards.ex: He always dresses to impress when he goes on a date.
cards.exUz: U doimo sanaga chiqqanida hayratlantirish uchun kiyinadi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni taassurot qoldirish maqsadida chiroyli va zamonaviy kiyinish.

cards.ex: You need to look presentable for the meeting with the clients.
cards.exUz: Mijozlar bilan uchrashuv uchun taqdimotga loyiq ko'rinishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi va toza ko'rinishga ega bo'lish, boshqalar oldida uyalmaslik uchun.

cards.ex: The CEO has a commanding presence that demands respect.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktorning hukmron ta'siri bor, u hurmatni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining ishonchi va kuchi bilan odamlarni boshqaradigan ta'sir.

cards.ex: He started to go grey in his early thirties due to stress.
cards.exUz: U stress tufayli o'ttiz yoshlarida oqarishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Soch rangi oq yoki kul rangga o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: She has a winning smile that can charm anyone.
cards.exUz: U har kimni o'ziga jalb qila oladigan g'alaba tabassumiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni o'ziga jalb qiladigan va yoqimli taassurot qoldiradigan tabassum.

cards.ex: Her pearl necklace added a touch of class to her simple dress.
cards.exUz: Uning marvarid marjoni oddiy libosiga nafosat belgisini qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Uslub va nafislik qo'shadigan kichik, ammo ahamiyatli element.

cards.ex: He had to scrub up quickly before the important meeting.
cards.exUz: U muhim uchrashuv oldidan tezda tozalanishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Toza va chiroyli ko'rinishga kelish, odatda shoshilinch tarzda.

cards.ex: After focusing on her health and fitness, she had a real glow-up.
cards.exUz: U sog'lig'i va fitnesiga e'tibor qaratganidan so'ng, u haqiqiy tubdan o'zgarishga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishda sezilarli darajada yaxshilanish, odatda o'z-o'ziga g'amxo'rlik natijasida.

cards.ex: Despite her fame, she always maintained a down-to-earth appearance.
cards.exUz: Mashhurligiga qaramay, u doimo oddiy ko'rinishni saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, tabiiy va sun'iylikdan holi bo'lgan ko'rinish yoki uslub.

cards.ex: Being in the public eye, she always has to be careful about her appearance.
cards.exUz: Jamoatchilik nazarida bo'lgani uchun, u doimo o'zining ko'rinishi haqida ehtiyot bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilikning doimiy e'tiborida bo'lish, mashhurlik tufayli.
